assessments.rationale: Metal housing provides superior resistance to mechanical stresses and ageing, maximizing durability and reliability under parameter (a) [Page 79]. It also eliminates the risk of microplastic and nanoplastic release during operational impacts and wear under parameter (p) [Page 80], while preventing premature degradation that leads to structural waste generation under parameter (r) [Page 80]. This ensures the vacuum cleaner maintains its functional performance and conditions for use over a long technical lifetime [Page 27, (22); Page 80, (s)].
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, due to increased product weight, material cost, and higher initial environmental footprint compared to lightweight recycled plastics, which conflicts with lightweight design optimization under parameter (t) [Page 80].

assessments.rationale: Reversible mechanical fasteners facilitate ease of repair and maintenance under parameter (b) [Page 79] by ensuring compatibility with commonly available tools and spare parts. This allows professional repairers [Page 29] or users to perform non-destructive disassembly to replace worn components, directly preventing premature obsolescence [Page 27, (21)] and reducing the amount of waste generated during the service life under parameter (r) [Page 80].
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, as reversible fasteners increase assembly complexity, part count, and production time compared to automated ultrasonic welding or adhesive bonding.

assessments.rationale: A BLDC motor maximizes durability and reliability under parameter (a) [Page 79] by eliminating physical brushes, thereby increasing the technical lifetime and mean time between failures. Furthermore, BLDC motors significantly reduce the consumption of energy while in service under parameter (g) [Page 79], aligning with Union energy efficiency targets [Page 3] and lowering the overall environmental footprint of the product during use under parameter (m) [Page 79].
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, because BLDC motors require complex control electronics and critical raw materials (such as rare earth magnets), increasing initial material footprint and production costs.

options_evaluated: Active fan cooling with replaceable filters
assessments.recommendation: Active fan cooling with replaceable filters
assessments.rationale: Active fan cooling prevents thermal stress and motor overheating, securing the durability and reliability of the motor under parameter (a) [Page 79]. Utilizing replaceable filters protects internal components from dust ingress, maintaining functional performance under parameter (s) [Page 80]. The availability and accessibility of these filters as consumables under parameter (l) [Page 79] ensures proper, long-term maintenance [Page 27, (19)].
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: User Maintenance/Convenience, as it requires the user to regularly purchase and replace filters, increasing the ongoing cost and generation of consumable waste under parameter (r) [Page 80].

options_evaluated: Fully modular architecture with easily swappable components
assessments.recommendation: Fully modular architecture with easily swappable components
assessments.rationale: A fully modular architecture optimizes ease of repair and maintenance under parameter (b) [Page 79] by allowing the direct replacement of individual failed modules (e.g., the suction motor, cord reel, or power switch). This ensures the availability and accessibility of spare parts under parameter (l) [Page 79], prevents premature obsolescence [Page 27, (21)], and minimizes the amount of waste generated by avoiding the disposal of entire functional assemblies under parameter (r) [Page 80].
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, as modular architectures increase product volume, weight, and structural complexity, potentially compromising lightweight design goals under parameter (t) [Page 80].

assessments.rationale: A corded AC power supply ensures maximum durability and reliability under parameter (a) [Page 79] by bypassing battery degradation, which is a primary driver of premature obsolescence [Page 27, (21)]. It eliminates the generation of hazardous battery waste under parameter (r) [Page 80], avoids the energy efficiency losses associated with battery charging cycles under parameter (g) [Page 79], and guarantees consistent functional performance under parameter (s) [Page 80] throughout the product's service life.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Design and Marketing stages, which prioritize cordless portability and user convenience, despite the trade-off of a significantly shorter operational lifespan due to battery degradation.
